parsing.text: Workday's parsing engine automatically maps raw resume text into structured candidate profile fields: Contact Details, Work Experience, Education, and Skills.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters have access to both the structured candidate profile fields and the original attached resume document in the recruiter review console.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters filter candidate pools using structured pre-screening questionnaires, knockout questions, and keyword searches across candidate records.
Modern Workday implementations leverage AI candidate matching (such as HiredScore integration) that evaluates applicants against job requisitions and assigns candidate match tiers/grades.

account.text: Workday career portals (`*.myworkdayjobs.com`) configure "Require Candidate Home Account" by default, necessitating that external candidates create a password-protected account.
Workday supports unified "Workday Candidate Profile" functionality allowing job seekers to reuse stored profile data across participating Workday career portals.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported resume file formats include `.pdf`, `.docx`, `.doc`, and `.txt`.

sizeLimits.text: Standard candidate career portals on Workday default to a 5 MB limit per uploaded document.

parsing.text: The Greenhouse parser extracts name, contact information, company names, and job titles into the candidate profile.
Document elements that cause parse failure include: files > 2.5 MB, image-only/scanned resumes, spaces between individual letters, tables, headers/footers, text boxes, and multi-column layouts.
Resumes with incomplete job titles (e.g. "Sr. Account Exec" vs. "Senior Account Executive") or company names missing legal identifiers (e.g. "Inc.", "LLC") result in partial parse failures.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters see both the parsed profile fields and an in-app preview of the original document directly in the candidate profile (via the Resume button or keyboard shortcut `R`).
Recruiters can download the original uploaded document directly from the profile's Documents tab.

searchFeatures.text: In Application Review, recruiters filter candidates using "Talent Filtering" chips with Required (`AND`) and Preferred (`OR`) parameters.
Recruiters perform full-text boolean searches (`AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, quotes) across all resumes and candidate records.
Auto-reject application rules in Greenhouse CANNOT be triggered directly by resume keywords; they are strictly configured on custom structured questions (Yes/No, single-select, multi-select).

account.text: Candidates applying via standard company job boards (`boards.greenhouse.io`) are not required to create an account or log in; applications use a single-page submission form.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Accepted file formats include `.pdf`, `.docx`, `.doc`, `.rtf`, and `.txt`.

sizeLimits.text: Greenhouse Recruiting enforces an automated resume parsing limit of 2.5 MB.
Files larger than 2.5 MB (up to the general 100 MB upload cap) attach to the profile but trigger an "unsuccessful resume parse", requiring manual recruiter data entry.

parsing.text: Lever parses raw resumes to extract full name, current/past organizations, job titles, and contact details (email, phone number, location).

recruiterVisibility.text: In Lever's "Fast Resume Review" interface, recruiters view the original resume in an inline document previewer alongside application question answers and candidate opportunity tags.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters search candidate pools using boolean strings and filter chips, including the specific `Resume:` filter chip which restricts queries strictly to parsed resume content.
Recruiters filter and segment candidates by opportunity stage, job posting tags, sources, and auto-archive rules configured on application forms.

account.text: Candidates applying via Lever job postings (`jobs.lever.co/<company>`) are not required to create an account or log in.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Lever accepts text-based `.pdf`, `.docx`, `.doc`, `.rtf`, `.txt`, `.odf`, and HTML formats.

sizeLimits.text: The maximum file size for uploading a resume directly to a candidate profile is 10 MB.

parsing.text: iCIMS extracts text from the resume and automatically populates the Person/Candidate Profile fields (contact info, work history, education, skills).

recruiterVisibility.text: iCIMS retains the original uploaded document and generates an on-demand PDF preview within the candidate's profile tab.
Recruiters can review both the structured Person profile elements and the original uploaded document.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters execute keyword, boolean, and relational queries across candidate profiles and parsed resume text.

account.text: Candidate portal workflows (`careermaster.icims.com` or custom client domains) standardly require applicants to create a password-protected candidate account or log in.

acceptedFileTypes.text: iCIMS supports `.doc`, `.docx`, `.pdf`, `.rtf`, and `.txt` file formats for candidate document ingestion.

sizeLimits.text: Default file size limits on iCIMS candidate portals standardly range from 2 MB to 5 MB per document.

parsing.text: Oracle Recruiting uses resume parsing partner integrations to automatically extract profile info, contact details, education, past experience, and skills into candidate profile fields.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view structured candidate profile records alongside the original uploaded resume attachment.

searchFeatures.text: Taleo evaluates candidates using ACE prescreening criteria: Disqualification Questions (immediate rejection), Required Criteria (mandatory minimums), and Asset Criteria (preferred nice-to-haves).
Candidates meeting all Required criteria and satisfying the Asset threshold are flagged with the "ACE Star icon" in the recruiter console and trigger automated candidate alerts.
Oracle Recruiting Cloud Redwood incorporates AI matching and rating based on parsed education, skills, and experience scores.

account.text: Taleo Career Sections require external applicants to register an account and log in.
Modern Oracle Candidate Experience provides candidate portal authentication to review status and manage submissions.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported file formats include `.doc`, `.docx`, `.pdf`, `.rtf`, `.txt`, `.htm`, `.html`, and `.odt`.

sizeLimits.text: In Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition, the default file size limit is 1 MB (`1,048,576 bytes`), controlled by the `Attached File Maximum Size` setting.
In modern Oracle Recruiting Cloud (Redwood Experience), bulk candidate resume creation supports up to 10 resume files or single ZIP files up to 25 MB.

parsing.text: Resume parsing automatically extracts unstructured data from candidate resumes and maps it into structured background elements on the Candidate Profile.
Successful parsing requires alignment with Standardization Mapping to ensure parsed data maps correctly to standardized background elements.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view candidate profiles containing structured background elements alongside downloadable and viewable resume attachments.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters search candidate pools by querying Candidate Profile background elements, standard fields, and keywords.

account.text: External candidates must create an account and authenticate on the SuccessFactors Career Site Builder (CSB) or Candidate Portal to submit an application.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Allowable file extensions for resume and cover letter fields are configured in the Candidate Profile Template (CPT), supporting `.pdf`, `.docx`, `.doc`, `.rtf`, and `.txt`.

sizeLimits.text: File attachment size limits across SuccessFactors Recruiting are governed in Admin Center (Company System and Logo Settings), standardly defaulting to 5 MB to 10 MB.

parsing.text: Dropping a resume onto the application form parses contact details, work experience, and education directly into structured form fields for candidate review.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view the candidate's SmartProfile containing extracted details, screening answers, and an integrated document preview of the original resume.

searchFeatures.text: SmartRecruiters uses SmartAssistant (and Winston AI) to rank and match incoming applicants against job requisitions, generating a candidate Match Score based on NLP skills taxonomy mapping, work history, seniority level, and education.
Recruiters filter candidate pipelines by SmartAssistant Match Score tiers (Very High, High, Medium, Low) and response criteria on custom screening questions.

account.text: Account creation is optional; candidates can submit applications directly via a single-page form or opt to apply using a saved SmartProfile account.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported file formats include PDF, DOC, DOCX, RTF, and plain text.

sizeLimits.text: Candidate uploads via the career portal UI accept files up to 10 MB.

parsing.text: Uploading a resume during application parses candidate name, email, phone number, work history, and education into application fields.

recruiterVisibility.text: The Application Review interface displays candidate application answers, custom fields, and evaluation scorecards side-by-side with an inline document preview of the original resume.

searchFeatures.text: Ashby Candidate Search provides full-text search across all candidate resumes, custom field filtering, stage filtering, and tag filtering.
Recruiters use application review rules and pipeline stages to archive or advance applicants based on question responses and scorecard ratings.

account.text: Candidates applying on Ashby job boards (`jobs.ashbyhq.com/<company>`) are not required to create an account or log in; applications use a single-page form.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported resume formats are `.pdf`, `.doc`, and `.docx`.

sizeLimits.text: Ashby supports document uploads up to 50 MB per file.
Resumes must be 16 MB or smaller to be parsed for full-text search indexing and form autofill.

parsing.text: BambooHR ATS parses basic contact details, employment history, and education from uploaded resumes to populate the candidate profile.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters see the candidate profile containing parsed details, application questionnaire responses, and an embedded preview/download link for the original resume file.

searchFeatures.text: BambooHR indexes uploaded resumes, cover letters, and application responses, allowing recruiters to search candidates using keyword queries.

account.text: Candidates applying via BambooHR career pages (`*.bamboohr.com/careers`) do not need to create an account or log in.

acceptedFileTypes.text: BambooHR supports resume uploads in `.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.rtf`, and `.txt` formats.

sizeLimits.text: The system enforces an upload limit of 20 MB per file.
Best practice for public career sites recommends keeping resume files under 5 MB to prevent upload latency.

parsing.text: Uploading a resume parses contact details, employment history, and education into candidate profile fields.
PDF files must be text-based; flat image scans fail to extract into candidate profile fields.
Each resume file must correspond to only one candidate profile.

recruiterVisibility.text: In the Candidates Tab, recruiters view parsed candidate profile information and can open or preview the original resume attachment.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters search candidate pools using keyword queries, evaluation scorecards, workflow stage filters, and pre-screening questionnaire rules.

account.text: Candidates applying via Jobvite career portals can apply as a guest or create/sign in to a candidate portal account to track application status.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Jobvite supports `.doc`, `.docx`, `.pdf`, `.txt`, `.rtf`, and `.html` resume formats.
Password-protected, encrypted, or image-only files fail to parse.

sizeLimits.text: In the application workflow, the maximum upload file size limit is 25 MB per attachment.

parsing.text: Workable parses resumes to extract candidate name, email, phone number, social media links, work experience, and education directly into the Candidate Profile.
Duplicate detection checks email addresses against existing records.

recruiterVisibility.text: In the pipeline view, the candidate profile displays parsed experience, education, skills, and application answers alongside an integrated preview of the uploaded resume document.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters filter and search candidates using keyword search, candidate tags, pipeline stages, and custom screening questions with auto-disqualification settings.

account.text: Candidates applying through Workable-hosted job pages are not required to create an account or log in.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported resume formats are `.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.rtf`, `.html`, and `.odt`.

sizeLimits.text: On the application form, the resume file size limit is 5 MB.
General and custom field uploads allow up to 20 MB per file.

parsing.text: JazzHR parses uploaded resume text to extract candidate name, contact info, and work history into the Candidate Profile.
JazzHR does NOT perform OCR on scanned or image-only documents; resumes without embedded digital text fail to parse into candidate profile fields.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view candidate profiles with parsed history and can open, preview, or download the original uploaded document.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters search candidate pools using keyword queries and filter by workflow stages, tags, and job openings.

account.text: Candidates applying on JazzHR-hosted job boards or embedded widgets do not need to create an account or log in.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported resume file formats are `.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.rtf`, `.txt`, and `.odt`.

sizeLimits.text: The resume upload limit is up to 5 MB per file.
General non-resume attachments in candidate profiles accept up to 8.5 MB.

parsing.text: Breezy HR parses contact information, employment history, and education from uploaded resumes into the candidate profile.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view the candidate profile with parsed summary data alongside an integrated document viewer displaying the original resume.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters filter and search candidate pools using keyword search, candidate tags, stage movement, and automated questionnaire scoring.

account.text: Candidates applying via Breezy career portals do not need to create an account or log in; applications use a single-page submission form.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported resume formats include `.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.pages`, `.rtf`, and `.txt`.

sizeLimits.text: Breezy HR accepts resume uploads up to 50 MB per file.

parsing.text: Recruitee requires an email address located within the body of the CV itself; if absent, the message is routed to the non-candidates mailbox folder and requires manual conversion.
The parsing engine extracts name, email, phone number, work history, education, social links, and custom candidate profile fields (e.g., certifications, languages).
Text must be highlightable and selectable, using standard web-safe fonts.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view the parsed Candidate Profile alongside an inline document viewer showing the original CV.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters search candidate pools using keyword queries, candidate tags, pipeline stages, and screening questions with auto-disqualification rules.

account.text: Candidates applying on Recruitee career sites do not need to create an account or log in.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported file formats for CV parsing in Recruitee include `.pdf`, `.docx`, `.doc`, `.odt`, and `.rtf`.
Plain text (`.txt`) files, image-only files without selectable text, and password-protected documents are NOT supported for parsing.

sizeLimits.text: Maximum file attachment size across job mailbox interactions is 25 MB.

parsing.text: Teamtailor Co-pilot automatically parses candidate resumes, extracting personal information (name, email, phone, location, LinkedIn link), work history, education history, and profile photo.
Skills and competencies identified in the resume that match skills configured in the company account are mapped directly to the candidate's profile.
Co-pilot actively detects "hidden instructions" in uploaded resumes (e.g. prompt injection, white text, micro-fonts, transparent styling meant to manipulate AI evaluations).

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view an interactive career and education timeline, an AI resume summary, auto-tagged skills, and an embedded preview of the original document.
When anonymous hiring mode is active, personal identifying information is automatically redacted from the candidate card and resume preview.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters filter candidates by matched skills/traits, smart filters, keyword queries, and automated triggers tied to screening questions.

account.text: Candidates do not need to create an account or password to apply on Teamtailor career sites.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported resume formats in Teamtailor include PDF, DOC, and DOCX.

sizeLimits.text: Standard application document uploads accept files up to 10 MB to 20 MB.

parsing.text: Personio integrates with Textkernel as its underlying CV parsing engine, extracting name, email, phone number, location, current employer, current job title, total years of experience, and public profile links.

Parsing errors frequently occur if: the document is an image or scanned PDF without a text layer; contact information is located within headers/footers; complex tables or multi-column layouts are used; font size is ≤ 8 pt; or skills are displayed as graphics/bar charts rather than text.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters see parsed candidate attributes across recruiting pipeline tables and can view the original attached CV inside Personio's embedded document viewer.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters filter candidate pools by parsed attributes (experience, job title, location), tags, application phases, and evaluation scorecards.

account.text: Candidates applying on Personio-hosted career pages are not required to create an account or log in.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Personio accepts `.pdf` and `.docx` as the standard supported formats for CV parsing into candidate profiles.

sizeLimits.text: The maximum file size limit for CV parsing is 10 MB per document (with API endpoints supporting up to 20 MB).

parsing.text: Rippling features automatic resume parsing that extracts candidate contact details, work history, and education into candidate profiles and application records.
Rippling's resume parser supports both English and non-English resumes.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view the parsed candidate record, interview evaluation scorecards, and an attached preview of the original resume document.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters search candidate pools using keyword queries, custom stage filters, and structured application question responses.

account.text: Candidates applying via Rippling job boards do not need to create an account or log in; applications use a single-page submission form.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Rippling Recruiting supports standard resume file formats including `.pdf`, `.docx`, and `.doc`.

parsing.text: Paylocity utilizes Natural Language Processing (NLP) resume parsing to extract contact details, work history, education, and skills to auto-fill application fields.
The NLP parser recognizes standard and non-standard job titles and varying layouts rather than relying solely on exact keyword matches.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view structured candidate profile records and have direct access to the original uploaded resume attachment.

searchFeatures.text: Parsed candidate information is indexed within the recruiter dashboard, allowing hiring teams to filter candidates by skills, experience level, education, and questionnaire responses.

account.text: Paylocity candidate portals standardly prompt applicants to create an account or provide email authentication to complete and track applications.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Paylocity Recruiting supports `.pdf`, `.doc`, and `.docx` file formats for candidate resume submissions.

sizeLimits.text: Application forms cap individual document uploads at 10 MB per file.

parsing.text: ADP's native parser extracts contact details, work experience, education, skills, and licenses/certifications to auto-fill the Candidate Profile schema.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters have access to both the structured candidate profile fields and the original attached resume document.

searchFeatures.text: ADP Workforce Now features screening question configuration and candidate relevancy scoring that compares applicant resumes against job requirements.
Recruiters filter candidates by screening question responses, background screening statuses, and keyword queries.

account.text: External candidates applying via ADP Workforce Now Career Centers standardly must create an ADP account or sign in to submit and track applications.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Supported resume formats across ADP Workforce Now include `.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.rtf`, and `.txt`.

sizeLimits.text: Standard document attachment size limits in ADP Career Center portals typically cap uploads at 5 MB (configurable up to 10–12 MB).

parsing.text: UKG Pro Recruiting parses uploaded resumes to extract name, contact details, work history, job titles, employer names, dates, education, and skills into candidate profile fields.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view candidate profiles populated with parsed data and can access the original attached resume file.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters filter candidate pools using keyword searches, qualification scoring, and prescreening questionnaires with knockout criteria.

account.text: External applicants are standardly required to create an account with email and password on the UKG Pro Recruiting portal.

acceptedFileTypes.text: UKG Recruiting environments support `.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.rtf`, and `.txt` file formats.

sizeLimits.text: Document uploads are generally capped at 5 MB to 10 MB per file.

parsing.text: Pinpoint partners with Affinda as its sub-processor for resume parsing and redaction.
The parsing engine extracts work history, contact details, and education, and automatically applies skill tagging (*Automatic Skill Tagging*) to the candidate record.
Bulk resume uploads allow recruiters to drag and drop multiple resumes simultaneously, with Pinpoint parsing each file to create candidate records without manual entry.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view a unified candidate profile showing the original document, parsed qualifications, auto-tagged skills, and application question responses.
When blind hiring is enabled, Affinda's redaction engine automatically redacts personally identifiable information (PII) from the recruiter view.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters filter and search candidate pools using boolean queries across parsed text, auto-tagged skills, candidate scorecards, and custom question answers.

account.text: Candidates applying via Pinpoint career portals are not required to create an account or log in; applications use a single-page submission form.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Pinpoint supports CV uploads in `.pdf` and `.docx` (as well as `.doc`, `.txt`, and `.rtf`).

sizeLimits.text: Upload file size limits support documents up to 30 MB for CVs (and 10 MB for general attachments).

parsing.text: Dover automatically parses uploaded resumes to extract and autofill First Name, Last Name, Email, and LinkedIn profile link.
The parsed text feeds Dover's AI sourcing and candidate evaluation algorithms.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view the parsed candidate profile, AI assessment highlights, and an integrated preview of the original PDF resume.

searchFeatures.text: Dover uses AI-driven candidate scoring and matching to evaluate applicants against job requisition criteria, along with keyword filters and stage tracking.

account.text: Candidates applying via Dover-hosted job application links do not need to create an account or log in.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Dover supports PDF as the primary document format, with an upload limit of 10 MB per file.

sizeLimits.text: Dover supports PDF as the primary document format, with an upload limit of 10 MB per file.

parsing.text: High-resolution images increase file size and cause parsing difficulties.
Wellfound candidate search relies primarily on information transcribed directly into candidate profile fields (skills, work history, education, roles) rather than raw resume attachment text.

recruiterVisibility.text: Recruiters view the candidate's complete Wellfound profile card, application pitch note, and downloadable/viewable attached resume document.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters search and filter candidates primarily by structured profile attributes: primary role, technical skills, years of experience, location/remote preference, and salary requirements.

account.text: A Wellfound candidate account is strictly required to apply for jobs or upload a resume.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Wellfound accepts only **PDF** (`.pdf`) and **Plain Text** (`.txt`) file formats for resume uploads.

sizeLimits.text: The resume file size limit is strictly 10 MB.
Fonts must be embedded when exporting to PDF, and design tools (e.g. Adobe Illustrator) should use the "Smallest File Size" preset.

parsing.text: Easy Apply auto-fills contact information, recent experience, and education directly from the applicant's LinkedIn profile.
Once an Easy Apply application is submitted, it cannot be edited or reopened to attach a different resume.

recruiterVisibility.text: In LinkedIn Recruiter, recruiters view the applicant's full LinkedIn profile alongside their attached resume file.

searchFeatures.text: Recruiters configure screening questions on Easy Apply and can mark them as "deal-breakers" (must-have qualifications).

account.text: A LinkedIn member account is strictly required to use Easy Apply.

acceptedFileTypes.text: LinkedIn Easy Apply supports Microsoft Word (`.doc`, `.docx`) and PDF (`.pdf`) formats.

sizeLimits.text: Resume file size must be less than 5 MB (2 MB recommended for mobile applications).

parsing.text: Uploading a resume parses work experience and education to generate or update the candidate's Indeed Resume profile.
Applications submitted via Indeed Apply pass parsed candidate payloads and resume attachments directly into integrated employer ATS platforms.

recruiterVisibility.text: Employers view candidate information via the Indeed Employer Dashboard or within their integrated ATS, displaying both the Indeed Resume profile and the original uploaded document.

searchFeatures.text: Employers configure screener questions with "deal-breaker" (required) status.
If screener questions are present in an external application flow, all screener questions must be replicated in the Indeed Apply setup.

account.text: Job seekers must have an active Indeed account to submit applications via Indeed Apply.

acceptedFileTypes.text: Indeed supports `.pdf`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.rtf`, and `.txt` file formats.

sizeLimits.text: File size must be under 5 MB for standard profile uploads (and under 15 MB for full API payloads).
